root_cause_label: Binary .npy Output Instead of Required Text Format
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent correctly solved the constrained optimization problem but saved the solution as a binary numpy .npy file from the very first attempt, never considering or checking whether the evaluator required a text-format output file.
t_err_evidence: Step 3 writes optimize_allocation.py with 'np.save("solution.npy", result.x)' — committing to binary numpy format without verifying what output format the evaluator expects; no spec-reading step preceded this choice.
t_commit_evidence: Every subsequent script version (v2 through final) also calls np.save('solution.npy', ...) without any reconsideration of format; the binary output format is locked in from step 3 and never revisited across all 32 steps.
trigger_explanation: The agent never read any task specification or checked what output format is expected. It assumed a binary numpy file would be acceptable without exploring any README, test scripts, or evaluation harness that would reveal the required text format.
